description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read the SKILL.md brand guidelines to discover the exact proprietary hex codes (#141413, #faf9f5, #d97757, #6a9bcc, #788c5d) and typography rules. (2) Open the draft PPTX using python-pptx. (3) Apply the correct brand background colors to each slide (dark #141413 for slides 1 & 3, light #faf9f5 for slides 2 & 4). (4) Apply Poppins (or Arial fallback) to all text runs with font size >= 24pt, and Lora (or Georgia fallback) to all body text < 24pt. (5) Apply smart text color selection: #faf9f5 on dark-background slides, #141413 on light-background slides. (6) The key proprietary trap: cycle accent shape colors through orange (#d97757) → blue (#6a9bcc) → green (#788c5d) → repeat for all non-text shapes, in document order. A generic agent will use wrong hex values, wrong color cycling order, wrong font threshold, or miss the cycling entirely. (7) Save the result as quarterly_review_branded.pptx.
